title: I love the app
body: Great app for building habits and organizing daily routines. It’s easy to use, customizable, and helps me stay consistent with my goals. The reminders are useful, and the clean design makes planning my day simple. Highly recommended!
author: Molalaa567.

title: Too expensive
body: Useful app, bit too pricy for a notepad with extra features.
author: Ivona.b
